base.description: For `set`, the branch the pull targeted as it was set. Retargeted since, it is cancelled.

repo.description: The repository the pull is on.

state.description: `set` has it merge once its checks pass; `cancelled` takes that back.

commit.description: For `set`, the hex object ID of the pull's head as it was set. A later head counts only when the pull's head repository belongs to someone who may merge it: a push by anyone else cancels it.

subject.description: The dev.knotless.pull set to merge, or no longer.

main.description: Kept in the account of whoever wrote it; for a private repository, in their repo inside the repository's space. Readers honour `set` only from the repository's owner or a collaborator, and `cancelled` from them or the pull's author. For each pull, the latest honoured record wins, by record key. A runner the repository names merges a pull set so once its checks pass at its head merged with its base.

description: A pull set to merge by itself once its checks pass, or that setting cancelled.
